metadata.hardware: Apple M4, Mac16,10, 16 GiB, 10 CPU cores

txiki.build: AppleClang Release, inspector ON, JIT compiled in, LTO off

web_tooling.adaptations: Re-enable upstream CoffeeScript as the last workload. Add a no-op onCycle hook to the shared bundle. The Longbridge adapter loads the classic bundle before JIT attachment, exposes the original Benchmark objects, runs them in the same order, and polls the JIT between workloads outside the runtime lock. Fork defaults maxTime=0 and minSamples=1.
web_tooling.comparison: Per-workload median of three fresh processes. Geometric means are computed per process for the named workload counts, then aggregated across runs. The four initially successful configurations and the two repaired launchers were measured in separate serial groups. Positive scores printed before timeout are retained.

longbridge_benchmark.comparison: Each process runs one first call, 64 warm-up batches, then 16 timed batches of 10 calls. The per-process value is the upper median of those batches. The table shows the median of three fresh processes per engine and workload. Original upstream worker for Longbridge and Bun. Shared JS batch driver with engine-specific launcher and timer for Node/V8, stock QuickJS-ng and txiki. Checksum outside timing.
